messages.subject: Customizing colours
messages.body_plain:
Dne pátek 10. dubna 2020 18:44:09 CEST, Magnus Bein napsal(a):
> Hi all, I am wondering if it is possible to change the colour scheme
> of rkward IDE and how I may be able to do that. Thanks, Magnus

Do You mean script editor? If so, open any script and go to menu Settings and 
search Editor Settings. If You mean command line theme, AFAIK it takes 
settings from Konsole, so open it and set profile there. If You mean app 
design, go to KDE System Settings, and set icon theme, window style, etc. 
there.

--

messages.subject: RKWard 0.7.1 for Windows 32 bit
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

On Thu, 16 Apr 2020 00:54:01 +0200
Marcus Glöder <m.gloeder at gmx.de> wrote:
> Hello all together,
> 
> Is there a 32-bit version of RKWard 0.7.1 for Windows? Unfortunately,
> RKWard 0.6.2 requires a full installation of KDE for Windows.

Sorry to say, but no, there isn't. While RKWard *could* be compiled for
32-bit, gathering all the dependencies is no mean feat, and doing so
for several architectures multiplies the problem. For this reason, a
few years ago, the maintainers of the KDE build servers have decided
to drop support for 32bit on Windows.

*In theory* it will still be possible to compile your own 32bit version
of RKWard. The general procedure is detailed, here:

https://community.kde.org/Guidelines_and_HOWTOs/Build_from_source/Windows

As the final step you'd run "craft rkward", and keep your fingers
crossed. To be honest, though, I'd be surprised, if it works.

Regards
Thomas
